item.title: Verbose beta 291
item.description:
Calls, two columns, and recordings that never stop

Mac

  • Home's Call tile records a call, and it can wait for the call to start. Your mic and the call app as two tracks. App audio moves to Edit Home and the Record menu.
  • Your next call shows on Home with Record when it starts. Turn it on from Home or Settings › Meetings. The recording takes the event's title, and attendees become speaker names.
  • Recording stops 15 seconds after the call app leaves, with Keep recording to undo it.
  • Keep stills of shared screens from a call in the transcript's margin. Settings › Meetings. Off until you turn it on; it needs Screen Recording.
  • Pages use the window's width: a large column and a side column, no wide gutters. Home, Library, Dictations, Thoughts, Journal, You, Templates, Ask, and Dictionary. Narrow windows keep one column.
  • Pages fade in, transcript tabs crossfade, and Home cards arrive and leave smoothly. Meters and live words stay steady. Limit Motion and Reduce Motion keep it to a short fade.
  • Summaries, results, and answers point out numbers and names not in the transcript.
  • Settings › Dictation has switches for medical, legal, and Bible and faith words. They fix spelling only. Your choices sync between your Mac and iPhone when iCloud sync is on.
  • Labels show in full, and search prompts and calendar dots are easier to see. On the Mac, the transcript's tabs fold into a menu when the window is too narrow for them beside Share.
  • When Apple Intelligence can't run, Summary lets you write one yourself. Run a template no longer appears there, since templates need Apple Intelligence too.
  • The tour and microphone screen say where audio can go: only your own iCloud, with sync on.
  • Closing Today's note while you type in it no longer leaves an empty window on screen.

Also on iPhone

  • Record a call in the Record tray: your Mac records it, or record on speaker.
  • Library's places sit in one row under search, so recordings start higher.
  • Milestones on your words calendar are off unless you turn on Show milestones.
  • A free recording keeps going as long as you need. It's saved in full.
  • If this iPhone can't run Apple Intelligence, Unlock says templates and Ask need it.
  • An idle keyboard session ends after 30 minutes unless you choose a different time.
